en: Black‑and‑white waterfront view of Malmö showing buildings along the quay with a small sailing boat in the foreground. At left and center are 19th‑century façades; to the right stands the brick Old Post Office with its two domed corner towers. Caption printed on the front reads "Malmö. Ö. Kajgatan." The reverse has a multilingual "CARTE POSTALE" header, publisher credit, and a Swedish handwritten note.
